verses.17:78: أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِۖ إِنَّ قُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ كَانَ مَشۡهُودࣰ ا

meaning: The root دلك (dlk) primarily means "to rub" or "to rub and press," often with the hand. It can describe rubbing a garment to wash it, kneading dough, or even time disciplining a person.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
